set system host-name DeviceB.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set protocols lldp interface all.explanation: Enables LLDDP protocols on all interfaces.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: Specifies the interface, 'all' means all interfaces.

set protocols lldp transmit-interval 60.explanation: Configures the transfer interval for the LLDDP protocol.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.explanation: The transmission interval is in seconds.

set protocols lldp holdtime 9.explanation: Configures the duration of the LLDP protocol.

set protocols lldp restart-timer 3.explanation: Configures the restart timer for LLDDP protocols.

set protocols lldp fast-transmit-count 3.explanation: Configures the fast transfer count of the LLDDP protocol.

unit 0 family inet address 10.10.10.2/24.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

set protocols lldp interface ge-1/0/1.explanation: This command enables LLDP (Link Layer Discovery Protocol) on the specified interface `[parameter1]`, allowing the device to discover and advertise neighbor information.

management-address 10.10.10.2.explanation: Configures the management address of the specified interface.

parameters.name: management-address
parameters.explanation: Management of address for network management.
